_comment: GovScan AI configured job sources. Direct watchers monitor official PSU/Govt career portals. Aggregators discover verified official notices across national portals.

watchers.name: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)
watchers.notes: Hires Scientists/Engineers, Technical Assistants, Scientific Assistants in Electronics and Physics.

watchers.name: DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation - RAC)
watchers.notes: Scientist 'B', Senior Technical Assistant (STA-B) in Electronics, Physics, Computer Science.

watchers.name: ECIL (Electronics Corporation of India Limited)
watchers.notes: DAE PSU hiring Technical Officers and Graduate Engineer Trainees in Electronics.

watchers.name: CDAC (Centre for Development of Advanced Computing)
watchers.notes: Project Engineers, Technical Officers, System Analysts in Electronics & IT.

watchers.name: AAI (Airports Authority of India)
watchers.notes: Junior Executive (Air Traffic Control - Physics/Maths required) & Junior Executive (Electronics).

watchers.name: SAMEER (Society for Applied Microwave Electronics)
watchers.notes: MeitY autonomous laboratory for Microwave, RF and Electronics R&D.

watchers.name: BEL (Bharat Electronics Limited)
watchers.notes: Defence PSU hiring Project Engineers and Trainee Engineers in Electronics.

watchers.name: CSIR-CEERI (Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute)
watchers.notes: CSIR electronics lab in Pilani hiring Technical Assistants & Project Associates.

watchers.name: NCS (National Career Service Portal)
watchers.notes: Ministry of Labour & Employment central portal for all public sector jobs.

google_alerts_rss.name: Google Alerts — Government Job Notifications
google_alerts_rss.notes: User will provide RSS feed URLs from Google Alerts. Treat as supplement to watchers only.

aggregators.name: Sarkari Result Latest Jobs
aggregators.notes: Scrapes latest job postings to discover official government notification PDFs and apply portals.

aggregators.name: FreeJobAlert Technical & Engineering Feed
aggregators.notes: Broadest index of state and central engineering, PSU, banking, and scientific vacancies.

aggregators.name: IndGovtJobs M.Sc & Scientific Jobs
aggregators.notes: Curated feed for M.Sc, Physics, Electronics, and Technical government recruitments.

health_check.note: If a watcher or Google Alerts feed shows no new items for 7+ days, send a Telegram alert about possible breakage.
